title: Replace image at selected element with new volleyball action photo

requirements.summary: Replace existing training program image with new volleyball action photo of player #7 Sarah setting the ball
acceptanceCriteria: The new volleyball action photo is saved at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'.
The element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[3]/div[1]/div[2]/a[2]/div[1]/div[1] displays the new image.
No reference to the old image remains in that component or element.

file_operations.description: Replace the image reference in the second program card (Setter Training) with the new generated asset at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'. The XPath points to the image container within the second card in the programs grid. Update the src attribute from the current 'generated/setter-training.dim_600x400.png' to '/assets/generated/volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'. Remove any reference to the old setter-training image file.
